scope: Research-only graduation evidence for two Beta target clusters. This file is not a Role Pack and is not routable or executable.
source_method: Public employer job pages were retrieved on 2026-08-30. The compact snapshot is role-language evidence only, never candidate evidence.

jds.title: Clinical Operations Manager
jds.snapshot: Multi-clinic operations, team management, utilization and documentation metrics, workflow implementation and process improvement.

jds.title: Clinical Operations Specialist
jds.snapshot: Prior-authorization accuracy and integrity; interpretation of medical records and clinical notes.

jds.title: Clinical Operations, All Levels
jds.snapshot: Site and vendor execution, study operations, timelines, scopes, budgets and trial delivery.

jds.title: Senior Director / Executive Director, Clinical Operations
jds.snapshot: Build and lead clinical operations, deliver Phase 1/2 studies, manage vendors, budgets and teams.

jds.title: Clinical Systems & Product Operations Manager
jds.snapshot: Document and improve care workflows; translate frontline workflow into scoped product requirements.

jds.title: Senior Associate, Strategy & Operations, Patient Operations
jds.snapshot: Analyze and improve patient workflows, run pilots, coordinate schedules and help scale operational systems.

jds.title: Business Operations Associate Manager, Care Operations
jds.snapshot: Operational efficiency and key metrics including workforce planning and care-team performance.

jds.title: AI Operations Associate
jds.snapshot: Build and scale automation supporting back-office and clinical operations in a regulated healthcare setting.

personas.facts: CRF maintenance, missing-data follow-up, internal study coordination; participant only
Screening logs, visit scheduling support, GCP training; no site ownership
Protocol document filing and data checks; no KPI or workflow redesign
Wet-lab experiments only; no clinical workflow evidence
Internal academic presentations only; no external stakeholder communication
Research-team scheduling coordination; no project or program ownership
R analysis of experimental data only; no care or clinical operations experience
Source-data verification support, query follow-up and investigator-file maintenance; no vendor or budget authority

negative_mappings: coordination support is not project/program ownership
documentation quality work is not KPI ownership
internal research communication is not external or executive communication
study support is not people, vendor, site or budget management

jds.title: Managed Care Liaison / Health Economics Field Lead

jds.title: Market Access Analytics Manager
jds.snapshot: Market-access RWE reports, dashboards, research plans and analytical data-review work.

jds.title: Health Economist and Outcomes Researcher
jds.snapshot: Own HEOR/RWE projects, curate clinical data and build health-economic models for stakeholder decisions.

jds.title: Director of Health Economics & Outcomes Research
jds.snapshot: Lead HEOR strategy, RWE analyses, economic models and enterprise value dossiers.

jds.title: Director of Research
jds.snapshot: Design studies, run analyses, publish evidence and work with health-economics partners on value demonstration.

jds.title: Real-World Evidence Scientist
jds.snapshot: Generate real-world evidence and communicate study findings in a digital-health setting.

jds.title: Director, HEOR
jds.snapshot: Lead HEOR evidence generation and value communication for therapeutic development.

jds.title: Senior Consultant, Commercial Operations & Analytics
jds.snapshot: Analyze data into client deliverables and advise commercial-pharma project direction.

personas.facts: Systematic-review retrieval, screening and supervised R meta-analysis; internal academic presentation
Clinical study data cleaning, descriptive analysis and manuscript figure support; participant only
R analysis of public research dataset; no claims/EHR, HEOR model or payer evidence
Wet-lab only; no evidence synthesis or analysis deliverable
Internal journal-club presentation only; no payer, client or external communication
Meta-analysis collaborator; no economic model, reimbursement or market-access experience
Commercial dashboard course project only; no confirmed real-world or healthcare data work
Literature review, study table checking and internal research summary; no study ownership or external deliverable

negative_mappings: clinical evidence synthesis is not payer engagement
R analysis is not cost-effectiveness, budget-impact or ROI modelling
internal academic presentation is not client, payer or executive communication
research collaboration is not HEOR, market-access, pricing or reimbursement strategy ownership
